text:
nina.partnerships: Quick kickoff for cloud marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Main asks: demo sandbox owner, VM/AMI region set, SKU packaging, legal checklist for trial EULA + DPA. Who can take sandbox bootstrap?

ben.cloudops: I can. Need list of account IDs and exact regions to seed images. Proposal: us-east-1, eu-west-1, asia-southeast-1. Should we include GovCloud/Azure GOV in phase 1?

tara.product: Product prefers visible Trial-14d SKU + Standard monthly SKU for discoverability. Trials retain data 30 days post-expiry then delete unless upgraded.

sanjay.legal: Legal needs localized EULA for EU, DPA link in SKU metadata, and explicit export-control language in offer docs. Also require support contact in metadata.

nina.partnerships: Support email will be support+marketplace@redwood.com. Plan: seed images in proposed regions, create one demo tenant per cloud, publish two SKUs. Sanjay can you draft the trial addendum?

sanjay.legal: Yes. ETA EOD Thu. Need final SKU blurbs and whether telemetry is opt-in for trial.

tara.product: Telemetry will be opt-out and documented in SKU notes. I'll drop hero screenshots (2:1) and a 60-word blurb by Wed AM. First line <80 chars.

ben.cloudops: I'll run AMI/VM image copies tonight. Sample commands I'll use will be posted to the ops vault. After seed I'll run smoke: auth, sample generate <300ms p95, and billing webhook events.

marketplace-bot: Note: staging-image-copy queued (job id jb-10098). Will ping on completion.

nina.partnerships: Timeline: aim to have demo tenants + assets by Thu EOD for legal/marketing review Fri. Any blockers?

sanjay.legal: None after I get SKU text.

tara.product: On it.

ben.cloudops: Starting jobs tonight.

nina.partnerships: Thanks team :thumbsup:
